source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-001
statement: A production client is constructed only from validated KMIPKit transport configuration; construction excludes caller-implemented Transport injection, raw request bytes, and generic TTLV input.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-002; ADR-0005
statement: Every production connection uses TLS 1.3 with rustls/aws-lc-rs and mutual TLS; full handshakes validate the server chain, validity, and hostname/SAN, with no production verification bypass.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-003
statement: Callers explicitly select CA trust or platform trust; configured caller CRLs are enforced, online revocation lookup is disabled, and platform trust loading fails closed with redacted diagnostics.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-004; threat model §2
statement: The client accepts in-memory or explicitly PEM/DER file-based certificate and supported unencrypted private-key inputs, reads selected files once, and rejects encrypted or unsupported key material without exposing credential bytes or paths.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-005; ADR-0014
statement: KMIPKit-owned key inputs and temporary copies use zeroizing ownership; diagnostics redact secrets and credential-bearing inputs; documentation records caller and third-party copy limitations.
implementation_location: crates/kmipkit-transport/src/config.rs; crates/kmipkit-transport/src/secret.rs; crates/kmipkit-transport/src/response.rs; crates/kmipkit-transport/src/raw_tls.rs; crates/kmipkit-transport/src/https.rs; docs/architecture/transport-security.md; docs/security/threat-model.md

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-006; ADR-0005
statement: TLS 0-RTT and key logging are disabled; a per-configuration in-memory session cache is capped at 16 entries and one local hour, isolates identities, inherits the full-handshake trust snapshot, and starts empty after rebuilding.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-007; ADR-0014; KMIP Specification v2.1 §§10.1.1–10.1.5, 10.2, 10.4
statement: Raw TLS exchanges caller bytes unchanged as one frame and validates the response TTLV header, declared length, overflow-safe limit, exact body, and padding before bounded allocation; raw framing remains a KMIPKit project contract.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-008; RFC 9112 §3.2; OASIS KMIP Profiles v2.1 §5.3.1
statement: HTTPS uses the configured endpoint and HTTP/1.1 POST with a configurable origin-form target, endpoint-derived Host, unchanged TTLV bytes, and exact required headers.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-009
statement: HTTPS endpoints and targets are validated; redirects, proxy discovery/use, compression, and automatic retries are disabled; a TLS-name override affects certificate-name validation only.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-010
statement: HTTPS accepts only bounded, correctly framed HTTP 200 responses with one expected Content-Type and unambiguous Content-Length; unsupported encodings, parser errors, truncation, and surplus responses invalidate the connection.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-011
statement: Default connect/write/read/total limits are 10/30/30/60 seconds; clients and exchanges may override them, and absolute deadlines bound queueing, connection setup, writer readiness, I/O progress, and dispatch.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-012; ADR-0014
statement: Atomic dispatch and response observation determine NotSent, PossiblySent, or ResponseStarted; post-dispatch timeouts/cancellation invalidate the connection and diagnostics preserve only safe categories and delivery evidence.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-013; ADR-0005; ADR-0016
statement: One client serializes exchanges to one endpoint, invalidates failed connections, never retries a failed KMIP request or selects an alternate endpoint, and applies documented resolver candidate/governor limits without claiming OS-controlled DNS bounds.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-014; ADR-0014
statement: Adapters enforce max_response_bytes before growth; the typed client passes CodecLimits::max_message_bytes(), checks response size before decoding, and preserves configured TTLV depth and element limits.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-015; ADR-0014
statement: KMIPKit-owned request copies are bounded, short-lived, redacted, and zeroized; successful responses use TransportResponse and initialized partial response storage is zeroized before release.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-016
statement: Documented bounded raw-TLS and HTTPS adapters serve the typed client and direct Rust callers; the typed constructor rejects caller-supplied Transport and the top-level facade does not re-export raw exchange.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md)
source_section: Requirements / FR-017
statement: Both production adapters reject requests over the configured positive cap before network activity; the default is 16 MiB, and the typed client rejects encoded requests above its effective codec limit before transport submission.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0013 (specs/013-production-transport/spec.md); KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0012; ADR-0013
source_section: Requirements / FR-018; KMIPKIT-0012-FR-001; ADR-0013 §2; KMIPKIT-0012 verification record
statement: The production client retains KMIPKIT-0012 ClientConfiguration separately from transport configuration, checks private registry provenance before request construction/encoding/exchange, rejects foreign provenance as InvalidInput/NotSent, and preserves same-client extension wire behavior.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.1.2; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.2-001; condition: when encoding or interpreting an OASIS Structure
statement: Encode every structure field in the order given by that structure description. Derived project tests demonstrate generic child-order preservation only; per the catalog review note they do not prove ordering for every KMIP Structure, so full structure-by-structure verification remains deferred.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.1.2; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.2-002-001; KMIPKIT-CLAUSE-SPEC-10.1.2-002; condition: when Big Integer length is not a multiple of eight
statement: Pad a Big Integer with the minimum leading sign-extended bytes needed to make its length a multiple of eight bytes. Verification IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases; these existing codec checks are prerequisites consumed by the typed client.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.1.2; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.2-002-002; KMIPKIT-CLAUSE-SPEC-10.1.2-002; condition: when encoding a padded Big Integer
statement: Include Big Integer padding bytes in Item Length. Verification IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases; these existing codec checks are prerequisites consumed by the typed client.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.1.5; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.5-001-001; KMIPKIT-CLAUSE-SPEC-10.1.5-001; condition: Text String or Byte String item
statement: Pad Text String and Byte String values with the minimum following bytes needed to reach a multiple of eight bytes. Verification IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases; these existing codec checks are prerequisites consumed by the typed client.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.1.5; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.5-001-002; KMIPKIT-CLAUSE-SPEC-10.1.5-001; condition: Integer, Enumeration, or Interval item
statement: Append four padding bytes after the value of Integer, Enumeration, and Interval items. Verification IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases; these existing codec checks are prerequisites consumed by the typed client.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.4; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.4-001-001; condition: KMIP messaging as specified by KMIP Profiles
statement: Establish and maintain channel confidentiality for KMIP messaging. Selected TLS 1.3 raw-TLS and HTTPS exchanges provide scoped transport evidence; this row does not claim a complete OASIS profile. The linked tests are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.4; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.4-001-002; condition: KMIP messaging as specified by KMIP Profiles
statement: Establish and maintain channel integrity for KMIP messaging. Linked derived project tests exercise valid protected TLS exchanges, but no test currently injects a tampered TLS record; direct negative integrity verification remains deferred and no official OASIS test case is claimed.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-spec-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §10.4; KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.4-001-003; condition: KMIP messaging as specified by KMIP Profiles
statement: Provide assurance of authenticity for KMIP messaging. Derived project tests verify the selected server trust/name decisions and observe client mutual authentication; this is scoped transport evidence, not a complete OASIS profile claim.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Profiles Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-profiles-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §5.3.1 item 1; KMIPKIT-REQ-PROF-5.3.1-001; condition: HTTPS Client profile; HTTP/1.1 selected
scope: profile_conditional; client_to_server; selected HTTP/1.1 overlap only
statement: Support HTTP/1.0 and/or HTTP/1.1 over TLS conforming to RFC 2818. KMIPKit 1.0 selects HTTP/1.1 over TLS 1.3; this selected overlap does not establish full HTTPS Client profile support. Test IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Profiles Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-profiles-v2.1-os.html)

scope: profile_conditional; client_to_server; selected HTTP/1.1 + TTLV overlap only
statement: Use HTTP POST for KMIP requests. This row verifies the selected HTTPS request behavior only and does not claim full profile support. Test IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Profiles Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-profiles-v2.1-os.html)

scope: profile_conditional; client_to_server; selected HTTP/1.1 + TTLV overlap only
statement: Support /kmip as a target URI. The configured default implements this recommendation; this row does not claim full profile support. Test IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Profiles Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-profiles-v2.1-os.html)
source_section: §5.3.1 item 4; KMIPKIT-REQ-PROF-5.3.1-004; condition: HTTPS Client profile
scope: profile_conditional; client_to_server; selected HTTP/1.1 + TTLV overlap only
statement: Enable end-user configuration of the target URI. The configured target remains origin-form under the selected endpoint authority; this row does not claim full profile support. Test IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.

source_document: OASIS Key Management Interoperability Protocol Profiles Version 2.1 (pinned: specification/oasis/kmip-2.1/upstream/kmip-profiles-v2.1-os.html)

scope: profile_conditional; client_to_server; selected HTTP/1.1 + TTLV overlap only
statement: Specify Content-Length on the HTTP request. The capture test checks a single exact length; this row does not claim full profile support. Test IDs are derived project tests, not official OASIS test cases.
